Vue Composition API: app.description:
**Vue 3 only — `vue` 2.7 does not export `createApp`.**
In Vue 2 use `new Vue({ el, render })` (prefix `vue-app`, snippet "Vue2: app"). The [@vue/composition-api](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@vue/composition-api) plugin ships a deprecated `createApp` shim.
Creates an application instance.

Vue: app.mount().description:
**Vue 3 only — Vue 2 has no application instance.**
In Vue 2 use `new Vue({ ... }).$mount('#app')` or the `el` option.
Mounts the application instance in a container element.

Vue: app.unmount().description:
**Vue 3 only — Vue 2 has no application instance.**
In Vue 2 use `vm.$destroy()`.
Unmounts a mounted application instance, triggering the unmount lifecycle hooks for all components in the application's component tree.

Vue: app.component.description:
**Vue 3 only — Vue 2 has no application instance.**
In Vue 2 use the global `Vue.component('feature', Feature)`.
Registers a global component.

Vue: app.directive.description:
**Vue 3 only — Vue 2 has no application instance.**
In Vue 2 use the global `Vue.directive('feature', feature)`.
Registers a global custom directive.

Vue: app.runWithContext.description:
**Vue 3.3+ only — no Vue 2 counterpart.**
Execute a callback with the current app as injection context.
